seeds.vh-1-0-0-0: In the frost-rimed belfry of Vesperhold, you hoist the bronze Clapper into its harness while Orison's fractured lip weeps cold grease onto your knuckles.
seeds.vh-1-0-0-1: Beneath the echoing bronze ribs of Orison, you swab copper dust from your woollen sleeves before shouldering the heavy metal tongue for its long descent.
seeds.vh-1-0-0-2: By the monastery's butter-lamp alcove, you check the hempen straps of your carrying cradle while the dawn wind rattles the frozen iron wind-vanes above.
seeds.vh-1-0-0-3: Within the dim sacristy, you trade your greasy apprentice smock for a stout dyer's jacket while the cathedral bells toll a low, muffled warning for the frost.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-0: Staggering onto the frost-slicked balcony, you feel the Clapper's bronze dead-weight shift against your shoulder-blades as the cloud-sea boils below the limestone sills.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-1: Passing the high buttery, you snatch a crust of rye bread from a wicker tray while old Brother Thomas mutters a prayer for the valley road.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-2: Near the salt-bins, you pause to scrape rime from your boot-soles while the iron Clapper hums a dull, shivering note against your spine.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-3: Ducking under the low arch of the choir-loft, you dodge a swinging tallow-bucket while the novice-master shouts last-minute cautions about the wind-slips on the stair.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-4: In the south cloister walk, you press your back against the warm stone chimney to ease the shoulder strap before tackling the vertical drop.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-5: Crossing the library garth, you watch jackdaws wheeling through the grey rime while the bronze tongue in your cradle taps a steady, rhythmic tattoo against your ribs.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-6: Pausing by the rain-cisterns, you splash freezing water over your wrists to clear the workshop sleep from your eyes before the descent begins.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-7: Under the stone vaulting of the Great Dormitory, you tighten your leather waist-belt while fellow apprentices murmur quiet bets on whether you will reach Lowgate intact.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-8: Standing on the threshold of the outer gatehouse, you watch the white vapour of your breath dissolve into the high mountain air before stepping onto the stones.
seeds.vh-1-0-1-9: Beside the brazier-pit, you warm your stiffened fingers over glowing charcoal while the master bell-founder watches you with a critical, squinting eye.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-0: Entering the damp gloom of the rope-loft, you smell tarred hemp and mutton tallow while Master Hobb dangles a hank of three-ply cordage for your inspection.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-1: In the buttery corridor, Mistress Garrow shoves a greasy tallow-skin into your coat-pocket with strict orders to grease your boot-seams before the middle stairs.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-2: Beside the north curtain wall, you watch iron-shod cart wheels crack the frozen ruts while a teamster curses his stumbling mare on the slope.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-3: Under the shadow of the winch-tower, a Cable Court bailiff blocks your path to demand a toll-token for the bronze you carry down to the valley.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-4: At the junction of the upper lych-gate, a terrace miller thrusts a bag of dried plums into your pouch, begging news of barley prices in Lowgate.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-5: In the open courtyard, a gust of wind off the glacier nearly lifts you from your boots, forcing you to lean your heavy frame into the rock-face.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-6: Passing the sheep-dip pens, you smell wet fleece and dung while an old shepherd waves a crooked hazel stick toward the grey stairs below.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-7: By the frozen fountain, a nervous novice presses a pewter charm of St. Jude into your palm to ward off the rock-slides on the Ninety Steps.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-8: In the charcoal-burner's yard, soot-stained lads roll pine logs through the slush while you sidestep a rolling roundwood with the heavy Clapper swaying.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-9: Under the timber pentice of the buttery stores, you adjust the canvas rain-hood over your cradle to shield the bronze tongue from dripping icicles.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-10: Beside the lime-kiln, white dust coats your boots as you skirt a steaming heap of slaking stone while the mountain air bites your ears.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-11: At the head of the cliff-mews, a caged mountain hawk screeches as you pass, its hood fluttering against the leather strap in the grey wind.
seeds.vh-1-0-2-12: In the alcove of the gate-saint, you brush a drift of dry snow from the stone saint's beard while the bronze Clapper hums softly against your shoulder.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-0: Stepping out onto the stone platform of the Ninety Steps, you peer down into the swirling mist where the first stair-flight vanishes into white nothingness.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-1: At the corner of the butter-stores, you dodge a sliding avalanche of roof-slate while your boots skid briefly on the black ice of the landing.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-2: Beside the wind-whistle mast, brass weather-gauges spin wildly in the draft while you catch your breath against the jagged limestone parapet.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-3: In the lee of the buttery gable, you tighten the breast-harness of your pack as the bronze Clapper gives a heavy, dead lurch against your spine.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-4: Near the old cider-press, frozen apple pulp clings to the cobblestones while you test the grip of your iron-nailed heels on the steep slope.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-5: Under the carved lintel of the porter's lodge, an old lay brother hands you a horn cup of bitter herb-wine to steady your nerves for the stairs.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-6: By the iron-plated postern, a frost-blackened lantern swings in its bracket, casting long, jittery shadows across the slippery limestone flagstones.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-7: At the head of the goat-path shortcut, you kick away a pile of wind-blown twigs to find the frozen edge of the stone-cut track.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-8: Beside the drainage sluice, yellow ice coats the iron grating while water gurgles sluggishly through the dark masonry under your boots.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-9: In the shelter of the salt-store wall, you pull your woollen muffler higher across your nose to keep out the biting needle-wind off the glacier.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-10: Near the broken mounting-block, a stray orange kitten watches you from a sled-runner with unblinking yellow eyes through the drifting rime.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-11: At the junction of the high mule-track, you pause to inspect a frayed mooring-ring set deep into the granite face by the old road-makers.
seeds.vh-1-0-3-12: By the timber drying racks, empty fish-hurdles rattle in the draft while you shoulder the Clapper and step firmly onto the head of the stair.
seeds.vh-1-0-4-0: Descending the initial granite gradient, you grip the frozen iron hand-rail as your boots strike the first of the Ninety Steps with a hollow ring.
seeds.vh-1-0-4-1: Slipping on a patch of black frost near the third landing, you catch your balance against the damp cliff-face with a sharp intake of breath.
seeds.vh-1-0-4-2: Passing a niche carved with the image of the first abbot, you touch the mossy stone for luck before plunging deeper into the mountain shadow.
seeds.vh-1-0-4-3: Hearing the iron Clapper resonate against your carrying frame, you pause to pad the lower rim with an extra fold of greasy wool.
seeds.vh-1-0-4-4: Stepping around a heap of wind-shattered pine boughs, you keep your eyes fixed on the narrow riband of stone winding down toward the mule yard.
seeds.vh-1-0-4-5: A sudden downdraft from the upper cirque tears at your collar, almost spinning you around on the narrow, sheer-drop tread of the stair.
seeds.vh-1-0-4-6: Catching sight of the mule yard's stone chimneys through the grey vapor, you lengthen your stride as the weight of the bronze tongue burns your shoulders.
seeds.vh-1-0-4-7: Bracing your knees against the downward plunge, you reach the lower terrace landing where the stable-gates loom large through the drifting mountain fog.
seeds.vh-1-0-5-0: Standing before the heavy oak doors of the high mule yard, you listen to the rhythmic stamping of iron-shod hooves on frozen cobbles within.
seeds.vh-1-0-5-1: Peering through the wicket-gate of the mule yard, you watch grooms breathlessly brush crusted snow from the flanks of shivering pack-beasts.
seeds.vh-1-0-5-2: Waiting in the freezing draft outside the stable entrance, you weigh the merits of taking a stubborn mule against the lonely peril of the foot-stairs.
seeds.vh-1-0-5-3: Rest the bronze Clapper against the mounting-block of the mule yard while stable-master Jago whistles through his teeth to call the beasts from the stalls.
